title: Majestic Greece: Athens, Mykonos and Santorini
alt: The caldera cliffs of Santorini dropping to the Aegean
transport: Private airport and port transfers, with ferries between the islands

stops.name: Athens
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Central hotel within reach of the Acropolis and Plaka

activities.name: Athens city tour with the Acropolis Museum
activities.description: A guided half day over the rock and through the museum below, with Syntagma Square and the changing of the guard on the way.

program.name: Athens
program.description: Three nights in the capital, with a guided morning on the Acropolis and two days to wander.

stops.name: Mykonos
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Island hotel within reach of Mykonos town and the beaches

activities.name: Mykonos town walk
activities.description: The windmills on the ridge, the chapels of the old quarter and the balconies of Little Venice hanging over the water.

activities.name: Optional: boat trip to Delos
activities.description: The short crossing to Delos, birthplace of Apollo, with the terrace of lions and the mosaic houses of the old merchant town.

program.name: Mykonos
program.description: Three nights in the Cyclades, with the old town on foot and two days for the bays.

stops.name: Santorini
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Hotel on the caldera side with the volcano across the water

activities.name: Santorini volcano and hot springs cruise
activities.description: A boat across the caldera to Nea Kameni, the climb to the crater, then the warm sulphur water off Palea Kameni.

activities.name: Oia sunset and the caldera villages
activities.description: The cliff path from Imerovigli to Oia, the blue domes above the water and the best sunset in the Aegean.

program.name: Santorini
program.description: Three nights on the caldera rim to finish, with the volcano, the hot springs and the sunset at Oia.

day_titles.8: The volcano and the hot springs

1: Arrival at Athens International and transfer to your hotel
Check in and the rest of the day at leisure
Optional: an evening walk around Monastiraki
Optional: dinner under the floodlit rock
2: Breakfast, then up the rock with your guide
The Parthenon, the Erechtheion and the Propylaea
The Acropolis Museum and its marbles
Syntagma Square and the changing of the guard
3: Breakfast, then the day as you please
Optional: the old stadium and the temple of Zeus
Optional: an evening in the lanes of Plaka
4: Breakfast and check out of your Athens hotel
Port transfer at Piraeus for the Aegean crossing
Met at Mykonos harbour and taken to your hotel
The evening free at Little Venice
5: Breakfast, then into the whitewashed lanes
The windmills on the ridge above the harbour
Chapels, bougainvillea and the balconies over the water
The afternoon free for a beach of your choosing
6: Breakfast, then the whole day yours
Optional: the boat across to ancient Delos
Optional: a swim at Ornos or Platis Gialos
Optional: a long lunch at a harbour taverna
7: Breakfast and check out for the island crossing
Port transfer and the ferry south through the Cyclades
Met at Athinios and taken up to the caldera rim
The evening free with the volcano across the water
8: Breakfast with the caldera below you
A boat across to the lava island of Nea Kameni
The climb to the crater rim and the steam vents
A swim in the warm sulphur water off Palea Kameni
9: Breakfast, then the cliff path towards Oia
Blue domes, white walls and the drop to the sea
The famous sunset from the castle ruins
Optional: a wine tasting on the way back
10: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to Santorini airport for your flight home

expert.name: Eleni
expert.quote: Mykonos for the nights and Santorini for the light. Give each island three nights and you will never feel rushed.
expert.tip: Book your Santorini hotel on the caldera rim in Imerovigli rather than Oia. Same sunset, half the crowd, and you can walk to Oia along the cliff path.

summary: Ten days through the classics and the Cyclades: three nights in Athens with the Acropolis and its museum, three on Mykonos for the old town and the beaches, and three on the Santorini caldera with the volcano, the hot springs and the sunset at Oia.
included: Included: 3 nights in Athens, 3 nights on Mykonos and 3 nights on Santorini with breakfast; private airport and port transfers; ferry tickets between the islands; all sightseeing as listed with entrance fees where stated; daily breakfast; a guided Athens city tour with the Acropolis Museum; a Mykonos town walk; the Santorini volcano and hot springs cruise.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Schengen visa fees; lunches and dinners unless stated; travel insurance; optional excursions; personal expenses. Hotels are named on confirmation: the operator quotes a standard class rather than fixed properties.
